Description
If you are considering investing because of its excellent store of value or to diversify your asset, Bullion Trading LLC brings an exciting opportunity for investors to invest in a versatile and popular silver product. The 100 Gram (10 x 10g) Valcambi Silver CombiBar .999 purity is now available at Bullion Trading LLC at low premiums.
Manufactured by the Valcambi Mint with over 50 years of background in producing high-quality and innovative products, the 100 Gram (10 x 10g) Valcambi Silver CombiBar also delivers this promise. The 100 grams (10 x 10g) are designed with pre-cut lines so that they can be separated perfectly into 10 bars weighing 10 grams each. Each bar features the Valcambi stamp, weight, and purity of the metal. Investors prefer this Valcambi Silver Combibar because of its unique design and the flexibility to break them into smaller size bars to sell or trade them individually.
Design of 100 Gram (10 x 10g) Valcambi Silver CombiBar
The observe of each bar is engraved with the Valcambi logo, metal content, weight of bar, and purity of the bar. At the bottom of the bar, it features the assayer’s mark to validate the authenticity of the bar.
The reverse of each bar bears the Valcambi Sussie stamp at the top and the metal purity and content at the bottom of the bar.
Main Highlights of 100 Gram (10 x 10g) Valcambi Silver CombiBar
Contains .999 fine silver for 100 grams of silver bar
Produced by Valcambi Mint
Packaged in a protective plastic along with an assay card for authenticity
Set of 10 silver bars, each weighing 10-gram
Observe that each individual bar has purity and weight of the bar and the Valcambi logo
The Reserve of the bar features the .999 purity stamp below the Valcambi logo
